snippet.title: A Baby CEO?! Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A struggling book company has decided to hire you, a baby, to be the new CEO? All you need to do is manage the budget, keep the company brand strong and make the employees happy. You can't talk? No problem! Give a thumbs up or down and try your best. 

Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3965540/A_Baby_CEO/
